signIn.title: Sign in to YVC
signIn.subtitle: One account. Apply to any opportunity without retyping your details.
signIn.createsAccount: Signing in creates your account if you do not have one yet.

telegram.panelIntro: Most volunteers reach us through Telegram, so that is the fastest way in.
telegram.step1: Open the YVC bot in Telegram.
telegram.step3: Tap the sign-in link the bot sends you.
telegram.checkTelegramHelp: Finish in the tab Telegram opens. This page will not sign you in on its own.
telegram.unavailableBody: The sign-in service is not reachable right now. Please try again shortly.
telegram.expiredBody: Sign-in links can only be used once. Start again to get a new one.

session.expiredBody: Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

notConfigured.title: Sign-in is not connected yet
notConfigured.body: This deployment has no authentication backend. Browsing opportunities works; anything that needs an account does not.
